scope: R3 / UNINST-01 item 350: a failed version probe now reports why it failed, instead of only that it failed
status: implemented-and-isolated-verified; no real user environment touched
gapClosed: The scan reported 版本探测失败，无法确认环境可用性 for every probe failure. run_capture_with_env already distinguished timeout, launch failure and non-zero exit with stderr, but probe_version returned Option and discarded all of it. A user with a broken environment could not tell a missing binary from a hung process from a CLI that exited with an error.

implementation.VersionProbe: New struct { version: Option<String>, reason: Option<String> } where exactly one side is populated, so a caller can never be told both ok and why-not.
implementation.probe_version_with_reason: Reason-aware entry point. probe_version is kept as a thin Option-shaped wrapper so existing callers (install.rs, commands.rs) are untouched and cannot change behaviour.
implementation.probe_simple: Generic single-command probe that names the entry it tried: a missing file yields 缺少可执行文件：<path>, a failed launch or timeout yields <label> 失败：<reason from run_capture>, and unparseable output yields <label> 的输出没有可识别版本：<snippet>.
implementation.coverage: Python, Node, Zig, Deno, Bun, Php, Llvm, Git, Gh and Mingw run through probe_simple and therefore report real reasons. Jdk, Go, Rust, Maven, Gradle and Adb keep the original file-parsing or multi-attempt probes and report 未取得版本；此类型目前不提供结构化原因 — an honest absence rather than a fabricated guess.
implementation.snippet: Failure output is flattened to one line and capped at 120 characters so a multi-line stderr never floods the status text.
implementation.scanWiring: scan_category formats status_detail as 版本探测失败：<reason> when a reason exists, and keeps 版本探测失败，无法确认环境可用性 otherwise. The structural failure branch is unchanged.

asserts: a missing node.exe names the exact path in the reason
a present but unrunnable node.exe reports node --version 失败 from the launch failure rather than a guess
version and reason are mutually exclusive
Maven, whose probe parses files, says 不提供结构化原因 instead of inventing one

rust.note: run standalone so the exit code is cargo test's own

notVerified: No real failing installation was probed: both fixtures synthesize the failure (absent file, non-executable file)
The timeout branch of run_capture_with_env is exercised elsewhere (detect::system::tests::reports_start_failure_timeout_and_empty_output) but not through probe_simple's label formatting
No UI fixture asserts the new status_detail text; the environments page already renders statusDetail
limitations: Six environment types still report no structured reason because their probes parse files or try several commands; saying so is deliberate
The reason is shown as free text in status_detail, not as a structured field a UI could filter on
Item 350 stays unchecked: the remaining gaps are a dedicated re-detect action and a repair path for corrupted plain directories
